test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed62d5a851f4ba0ad172e13f05b2021586a311c8ff6420bea0da7837302b7cc6.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +12.

Let's check each option:

1. XO – UA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dc469650dc82df18949364a2f37e1107c24737f2cd8aadf23c5315d408baf4e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +12.

2. WN – TZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3648e36c89c848ebca8203a4d028976063437348bfa2e42e436adba88b75b8ed.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +12.

3. VM – SY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0194168e0d993293de1c708a8dc27266835e730cc386dc53ec992597917cfbfc.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +12.

4. PG – NS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5469f1458b2d92cb2e8fba17e950e08e5a18311fb3d1449e0513d6fd00211ce.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -3, +12.

Thus, PG – NS is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
